factual_methodology.summary: 23 Oct PMI evidence cross-checked with dated US Treasury, ONS 23 Oct, Michigan 23 Oct, Census 15 Oct 745.0bn/0.8% nominal, BEA 30 Sep August real PCE 0.6%, real DPI 0.0%, ICI 22 Oct assets 7.94tn/+21.49bn, EIA 6 Oct outlook inputs 1 Oct; market oil and India survey are explicitly secondary and qualified.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Six causal sections in both languages; dated surveys, nominal versus real observed demand, survey/income timing, rates, liquidity asset stocks and falsifying future observations; conclusions avoid template meta-narration.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Two comparable numeric bar charts, two material comparative tables, one causal flow and one map in both locales, identical numbers, no unverified route metrics.

research_depth.summary: Both editions exceed minimum 1700 substantive words and have six analysis headings; figures distinguished by observation vintage and measurement units; 15 URL-matched citations, 11 distinct hosts.

evidence_traceability.summary: EIA outlook is directly linked with dated forecast-input cutoff; Census, BEA, ICI, ONS, Treasury and Michigan primary releases support core numerical claims. Secondary India survey/oil quote are expressly attributed, not passed off as primary.

counterfactual_review.summary: Euro area remains expansionary despite slower PMI; August real consumption/September nominal retail counters collapsed-demand assumption; ICI asset stock cannot prove net subscriptions or risk rotation; nominal yields cannot isolate causal components; energy prices cannot confirm physical disruptions.

contrary_evidence: September US nominal retail sales rose 0.8% and August real PCE rose 0.6% despite low October consumer sentiment; dates and nominal/real bases differ.
October euro-area PMI 51.9 remains expansionary; UK and India flash PMIs strengthened.
Treasury two- and ten-year yields shifted in parallel; the movement does not identify its inflation, real-rate and term-premium decomposition.
ICI money market assets are a stock and do not establish net investor flows or a universal institutional consensus.
A secondary market oil price report and an older EIA forecast cannot establish October 23 physical supply loss.
limitations: Institutional sources for numerical anchor claims independently checked; not every sector-specific PMI subindex was separately authenticated.
Additional secondary-source details of India flash survey and oil market commentary carry narrower provenance than the primary statistics.
Node repository-wide build, dry-run Worker and Cloudflare deploy checks must be executed by the repository's GitHub Actions pipeline; source-level QA does not certify those CI/deployment outcomes.
notes: r2 supersedes retained r1 rejection. The approval SHA binds precisely to stage commit and contents. Publisher copies approved content atomically, then hosted GitHub CI and Cloudflare production smoke checks must confirm deployment.
